notes: 150-task subset (114 test + 36 validation, all 11 families; src/asta_bench/parity_task_ids.txt). Agent: AstaBench's `astabench/react` Inspect solver on both sides (inspect_ai 0.3.203, anthropic SDK 0.97.0, fork smiky2011/asta-bench@04293fb eval code); on Harbor it runs inside the task container through the InspectSolver bridge (inspect-solver@0.1.0, `inspect eval --no-score`) and the Harbor verifier scores; on the original side `scripts/harbor_parity_original_side.py` (fork d1d51e1) runs one `inspect eval` per sample with the fork's own Inspect scorers. Model: solver and every LLM judge use `claude-haiku-4-5`. Same flags on both sides (`--max-tool-output 65536`), same per-task time limit (Harbor [agent] timeout_sec, passed to Inspect as --time-limit on the original side). Metric: each task's reward is its family's upstream headline metric in [0,1]; a run's score is the mean over the tasks that received a score, x100. One original-side sample (run 1, sqa-test-5) is unscored because the upstream SQA scorer raises on its answer (Harbor treats the same case as a verifier error, no reward); counting it as 0 gives 26.89 for that run. Harbor side: Harbor 0.26.0 on Daytona, 20 concurrent trials, override_memory_mb=8192 and override_storage_mb=10240 (Daytona's per-sandbox cap is 8 GB). Original side: Windows laptop, WSL2 Ubuntu 22.04, i9-13900H, 15.4 GB RAM visible to WSL, Docker Engine 27.1.2, 4 concurrent samples. Re-run attempts (superseded attempts are kept in the uploaded artifacts): original run 1 paper-finder-test-semantic-1 (Asta tool server HTTP 502 during solving) and run 2 super-expert-test-g-transformer (sandbox connection lost); Harbor arxivdigestables-clean-test-cce90f19 and core-bench-hard-test-capsule-6049678 in all three runs (Daytona image build stalled, EnvironmentStartTimeoutError) and run 2 paper-finder-test-semantic-5 twice (verifier timeout, then a proxy HTTP 502 that the judge retry did not cover; fixed afterwards). Per-family means are in the README.
